## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações shows no avatar/name/email (still the Story 2.4 toggle-only stub) and has no way to edit the display name (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.3 scope).

**Approach:** Add a profile header (52dp avatar + name/email) above the biometric toggle. A pencil icon switches the name to an inline `AppTextField`; it becomes a check that saves via the existing `account-settings-update` PATCH and reverts to display mode. Tapping away unconfirmed reverts without saving.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `AccountSettingsDto` decodes `displayName`/`email` too (required strings), full-contract-decode precedent as `DashboardNarrativeDto`.
- No new network call: `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s success branch also sets new `_currentDisplayName`/`_currentEmail` (default `''`) from that response.
- New `setDisplayName(String)`: own `_nameGeneration` guard (shape of `setBiometricEnabled`'s `_generation`, kept separate), **not optimistic** — await `AccountRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName` (`{'displayName': name}`), set `_currentDisplayName` only on success.
- Cubit reads `displayName`/`email` from the repository at construction. New state: `isEditingName`, `nameDraft`, `isSavingName`, `nameErrorMessage`. New methods: `startEditingName()` (draft = current name), `updateNameDraft()`, `cancelEditingName()` (no-op while saving), `confirmEditingName()` — trims draft; empty/unchanged reverts with no PATCH; otherwise saves, staying in edit mode with the error on failure (draft kept) or reverting with the new name on success.
- Screen: header is the first scroll-`Column` child, above the toggle. `Avatar(size: AvatarSize.large)`, caller derives initials (first letter of first + last word). Name: `textTitleSm`+`colorTextPrimary`. Email: `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle`+`colorTextSecondary`. Icon: `Icons.edit`/`Icons.check`, `dialogIconSize`, `colorPrimary`, in `InkWell`+`ConstrainedBox(minHeight/minWidth: insertionModalTapTargetMin)` (tap-target fix, same as spec-8-2's retry link). Field + check icon in one `TapRegion(onTapOutside: cancelEditingName)`. Field: `AppTextField(controller, errorText: nameErrorMessage)`, no label/hint.
- `_announce` fires on a save failure, same `BlocListener` convention as the toggle's error.
- Keep `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s name even though it now also sets `displayName`/`email` — renaming ripples into `main.dart`/`vault_lock_screen.dart` for no functional gain.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** a second fetch for displayName/email; an optimistic flip for the name; persona/logout/delete UI (Stories 8.4/8.5); merging name-edit into the toggle's own state.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap pencil | `isEditingName: false` | Field replaces name, draft = current, icon -> check | N/A |
| Confirm, changed non-empty name | tap check | PATCH, saving indicator, success -> display mode, new name | Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft kept |
| Confirm, empty/unchanged draft | tap check | Reverts immediately, no PATCH | N/A |
| Tap away, not saving | outside tap | Reverts, draft discarded, no PATCH | N/A |
| Tap away, saving | outside tap | No-op, save completes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- add `displayName`/`email`
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart:11-47` -- add `updateDisplayName`, mirrors `updateBiometricEnabled`
- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart:15-58` -- add `currentDisplayName`/`currentEmail`/`setDisplayName`
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart:20-139` -- fields + boot-fetch piggyback + `setDisplayName`
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` -- state/methods per Boundaries
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:104-120` -- header, `TapRegion`, initials helper, `_announce`
- `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart` / `app_text_field.dart` -- reused as-is (first real `AvatarSize.large` consumer)
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1737-1819` -- `PATCH /account/settings` (frozen), `displayName` optional, `minLength:1`/`maxLength:80`; `README.md:45` maps it to `account-settings-update`
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:116` + raw prototype `toggleEditProfile`/`saveProfile`/`editIcon` -- pencil/check UX source
- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-8-context.md` -- authoritative AC source (no FR in `requirements.md` covers this)
- `test/features/account/**` -- extend `_FakeAccountSettingsRepository` + new coverage

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- decode `displayName`/`email`
- [x] `account_remote_data_source.dart` -- `updateDisplayName`
- [x] `account_settings_repository.dart`/`_impl.dart` -- getters + `setDisplayName`, boot-fetch piggyback
- [x] `account_settings_cubit.dart` -- edit/draft/save/cancel state machine
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- header, inline edit, `TapRegion`, tap-target fix, announcement
- [x] Tests: I/O matrix + the 3 RNF09 failure types for `updateDisplayName`; update existing fakes for the widened interface

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given display mode, when the pencil is tapped, then the name becomes editable (pre-filled) and the icon becomes a check.
- Given a changed non-empty draft, when the check is tapped and save succeeds, then the screen shows the new name in display mode.
- Given a save fails, then the field stays editable with the typed text and an inline error.
- Given an unconfirmed edit, when the user taps outside the field/icon, then the screen reverts with no change sent.

- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- expected: DTO regenerated, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test test/features/account` -- expected: all pass

**Inline-edit UI**

  [`account_settings_screen.dart:204`](../../lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart#L204)
- The pencil/field-and-check row, including the `TapRegion` that scopes tap-away-to-revert to exactly the field+icon pair.
  [`account_settings_screen.dart:109`](../../lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart#L109)
- Initials extraction — grapheme-cluster aware (`.characters.first`), a code-review patch over the original surrogate-pair-unsafe `substring(0,1)`.
  [`account_settings_screen.dart:88`](../../lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart#L88)

**Tests**

**Code review complete.** 0 `decision-needed`, 7 `patch`, 4 `defer`, 6 dismissed as noise.

Findings written to the review findings section in `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-3-profile-name-editing.md`.

**Patch findings (fixable now, no ambiguity):**
1. `confirmEditingName()` saves the locally-trimmed name instead of the repository's server-echoed value — defeats the repo's own "echo wins" fix [account_settings_cubit.dart:291]
2. New `DashboardCubit` sibling listener re-announces "narrativa indisponível" on every subsequent dashboard refresh, not once [account_settings_screen.dart:485-504]
3. `_nameController` isn't reseeded on remount mid-edit — field shows blank but confirming saves the stale, invisible draft [account_settings_screen.dart:52-57]
4. `fetchBiometricEnabled()` discards a still-valid displayName/email piggyback whenever only `_generation` (not `_nameGeneration`) is superseded [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:111-144]
5. No test uses `interceptAnnouncements` for the name-save-failure path, unlike its siblings [account_settings_screen_test.dart]
6. `setDisplayNameGate` is wired into the fake but never used — saving/tap-away-while-saving untested at widget level [account_settings_screen_test.dart:68-80]
7. Profile e-mail `Text` has no overflow handling, unlike the adjacent name `Text` [account_settings_screen.dart:220-224]

**Deferred (real but pre-existing or unfixable client-side):** close()-in-flight guard untested (mirrors existing gap), `_nameGeneration` can't order backend-side request processing, duplicate undocumented deferred-work entries, test-summary.md tally drift.

**Dismissed (6):** construction-time-only name/email read (explicit frozen-spec decision), overlapping-save race on `isSavingName` (same accepted risk class as the toggle), missing client-side 80-char limit, no autofocus, no keyboard-submit wiring, and the shared `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` token reuse — all either spec-sanctioned or out-of-scope UX niceties, not defects.

**How would you like to handle the 7 `patch` findings?**
1. **Apply every patch** — fix all of them now, no per-finding confirmation
2. **Leave as action items** — they're already in the story file
3. **Walk through each patch** — show details for each before deciding
PROCESSO: 1

76	### Review Findings
77	
78	- [ ] [Review][Patch] `confirmEditingName()`'s success branch emits `displayName: trimmed` (the locally-sent, merely-trimmed string) instead of re-reading `_repository.currentDisplayName` — defeats the repository's own code-review patch that sets `_currentDisplayName` from the response's echoed `dto.displayName` so any backend-side normalization is reflected locally. The cubit never re-reads the repository after construction, so a divergence persists for the rest of the singleton's session. [account_settings_cubit.dart:291]
79	- [ ] [Review][Patch] The new sibling `BlocListener<DashboardCubit, Resource<DashboardAggregate>>` added to catch the narrative-errors-before-aggregate-resolves race has no `listenWhen` — it re-announces "narrativa indisponível" on every subsequent `DashboardCubit` emission with `totalCount > 30` (e.g. each further entry save via `confirmedWrites`) for as long as the narrative stays in `ResourceError`, not just once for the missed transition the fix was written for. [account_settings_screen.dart:485-504]
80	- [ ] [Review][Patch] `_nameController` is created empty in `initState()` on every mount; the only sync (`BlocListener` on the `!previous.isEditingName && current.isEditingName` transition) fires on state *transitions*, not on initial build. Leaving Configurações mid-edit (e.g. via the back arrow, which never calls `cancelEditingName`) and reopening it shows a blank field while the cubit's singleton state still holds `isEditingName: true` with the old `nameDraft` — tapping the check icon in that state silently saves the stale, invisible draft rather than the (empty) field the user sees. [account_settings_screen.dart:52-57]
81	- [ ] [Review][Patch] `fetchBiometricEnabled()` checks `generation != _generation` and returns early *before* ever checking `nameGeneration == _nameGeneration` — a fetch superseded only on its biometric-toggle generation (e.g. the double boot-time call in `main.dart`/`CerneApp.initState()` racing past the 2s `main()` timeout) discards its own still-valid `displayName`/`email` piggyback too, even though no `setDisplayName` call happened in between. [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:111-144]
82	- [ ] [Review][Patch] No test uses `interceptAnnouncements` for the name-save-failure path — the sibling toggle-failure and narrative-failure tests in the same file all assert the accessibility channel receives the announcement, but the new "a failed save keeps the field editable..." test only checks `TextField`/error text, so a dropped or inverted `_announce` call on name-save failure would pass the full suite. [test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart (profile header group)]
83	- [ ] [Review][Patch] `_FakeAccountSettingsRepository.setDisplayNameGate` is wired into the fake's `setDisplayName` but no test ever sets it — the saving-indicator (`CircularProgressIndicator`) and the "tap away while saving is a no-op" I/O-matrix row are proven only at the cubit level, never against the real screen widget, unlike every other row/AC in the matrix. [test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart:68-80]
84	- [ ] [Review][Patch] The profile e-mail `Text` has no `maxLines`/`overflow` handling, unlike the adjacent name `Text` which was patched for exactly this (backend allows up to 80 chars) — a long e-mail can still wrap to multiple lines and misalign the row. [account_settings_screen.dart:220-224]
85	- [x] [Review][Defer] `confirmEditingName()`'s `if (isClosed) return;` guard (same close()-race shape as `toggleBiometric`'s own) has no dedicated test — mirrors `toggleBiometric`'s own identical, also-untested guard, not a gap newly introduced for this feature. [account_settings_cubit.dart:267]
86	- [x] [Review][Defer] `_nameGeneration` only orders this client's own local state; it can't prevent the backend itself from processing two overlapping `setDisplayName` PATCH requests out of order, so a locally-"superseded" call's name could still be the one actually persisted server-side. Same residual risk class the existing `_generation` guard already carries for the biometric toggle, not fixable from the client given the frozen contract. [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:152-176]
87	- [x] [Review][Defer] The `DashboardNarrativeCubit.confirmedWrites` "no `onError` handler" observation is recorded nearly verbatim in both `deferred-work.md` and spec-8-2's own Review Findings, with no cross-reference between the two — a future fix to one is likely to leave the other stale. [_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md]
88	- [x] [Review][Defer] `tests/test-summary.md`'s hand-maintained pass-count tally has now drifted from the real `flutter test` count more than once (this diff's own edit corrects a prior miscounted baseline); nothing automated stops a future story's tally from drifting the same way again. [_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/tests/test-summary.md]
